![OVERWORLD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0b13aad68634b9e3c17c2165719c424dabf329a.png)

Welcome to MirtopiaSMP, the ultimate vanilla++ Minecraft experience!

🌍 What Makes MirtopiaSMP special?

Vanilla++ Gameplay: Teleportation commands (/home, /warp, /tpa), land claims, no pay-to-win perks. Just true Minecraft survival. 

Semi-Anarchy Environment: Freedom to explore, build, raid, and PvP

Economy System: You will be able to sell ores at the PLOTWORLD Store to earn in game server money to be able to purchase land and items.

Multiple Beautiful Custom Worlds: 

SKYBLOCK: Experience the classic skyblock minigame inside the server, your own private island.

PLOTWORLD: A long-term world with no resets. Plot purchase/pvp free zone.

OVERWORLD: A world with periodic resets based on monthly community polls. Custom content like Dungeons/Structures/mob bosses/new biomes.

Community-Powered: Work alone, join forces, or clash with others.

📜 Server Info 

IP: mirtopiasmp.playit.game

Versions: Minecraft Java 1.21.8 

Rules & Community Guidelines: Be respectful, no cheating and follow the rules 

🧭 Getting Started Quickly 

Launch Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.8 Go to Multiplayer -> Add Server. Name it MirtopiaSMP and enter: mirtopiasmp.playit.game Join it and start playing! 

🤝 Join the Community 

Join the Discord to meet players, share builds, get updates, and hear about the latest news.
